title: START of background tasks: INTERVAL vs TIME (the six-hour rule), FROM data and RETRIEVE, ENDDATA, LENGERR, PROTECT vs an abending starter

scenarios.summary: START INTERVAL(0) FROM 20 bytes: one GT02 task retrieves them, then ENDDATA
START with no FROM: the first RETRIEVE is already ENDDATA
at 10:00, TIME(103000) runs at 10:30, but TIME(093000) is in the past within six hours and runs at once, so the second START runs first
30 bytes of FROM data into a 20-byte RETRIEVE area: truncated, LENGERR, LENGTH set to 30
the starter abends after two STARTs: the plain START still runs its task, the START PROTECT is discarded
mode Z matches no WHEN (and there is no WHEN OTHER): no START is issued and no GT02 task runs, but the screen still says STARTS ISSUED
